rawRequired: trade tape with exchange timestamps, price, size, aggressor side or reconstruction provenance

qualityPolicy.missingOrDuplicateBars: FAIL historical validation; do not impute for promotion
qualityPolicy.rawFeedGap: FAIL affected evaluation or explicitly SKIP the partition; never silently bridge
qualityPolicy.warmup: At least max frozen lookback (20 bars), excluded from scored period

splitPlan.parameterPolicy: Frozen parameters; no changes between IS and OOS; robustness is descriptive around frozen values and cannot select/promote a best setting.
